name: Announcer
message: 「...Well then, here are the news highlights for today」
A news program plays on the TV I switched on at random.

name: Iori
message: 「Whew, I can finally take a break」
With the semifinals safely over, I return to my room to catch my breath.
After the second match, I went to check on Asahi and Momiji individually, but...

name: Iori
message: 「Somehow, both of them were so indifferent...」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Oh, Iori-sensei. I’m fine, I don't have any injuries」

name: Asahi
message: 「As for the match... unfortunately, my skills weren't enough to reach Momiji-san」

name: Asahi
message: 「You went out of your way to teach me Tengen Saimei-ryuu, and I’m sorry I couldn't deliver results...」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m fine on my own, so please go check on Momiji-san」
After being told that, I went to see Momiji, and—

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, thank you. Because of your guidance, I was able to make it through safely」

name: Momiji
message: 「About the match... I just think it was a case of what was meant to happen, happening, that's all」

name: Momiji
message: 「While I won, I was made to realize that I’m still immature」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m fine, so please go check on Asahi-san」
I had hoped I could encourage them or celebrate with them, but the atmosphere was far from that.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, they are really delicate right after a match...」
Both of them seemed more worried about the other than themselves. They must each have their own thoughts on the matter.

name: Announcer
message: 「Now, next is a topic about a rare astronomical show」

name: Announcer
message: 「Coming up on July 21st, a rare astronomical phenomenon where the moon is hidden in the Earth's shadow, a total—」
The 21st is the final day of school for the first term. From the day after, Murakumo Academy enters its long summer break.
By this time next week, the finals will be over, the heat of the Martial Festival will have faded, and everyone should be busy making plans for summer vacation.
Will I have been called back to my original unit by then?

name: Iori
message: 「...I have to think about a training menu for everyone during summer break」
Students who want to grow don't neglect hard training even during summer break. I want to leave them with something, even if it's just a little bit.
Just as I was thinking that—
A call comes through.
I check the name of the person calling... and freeze up.

name: Iori
message: 「Ta, Takahisa...！？ Wh, why now of all times...！」
Since graduating from the academy until today, I’ve never contacted him. And I haven't heard from him either.
I thought we'd never be able to talk again. And yet, why.
With trembling fingers, I press the answer button.

name: Iori
message: 「...H-Hello?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Yo, Iori？ How've you been？」
...It was Takahisa's voice, after so long.

name: Iori
message: 「Y-Yeah... How about you？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Eh, so-so, I guess. Just getting along fine back at my parents' place.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. I'm glad to hear that.」
Hearing Takahisa's voice brings old memories flooding back.
The days spent at the academy, all the crazy stunts Takahisa and I pulled. Every single one of them was a nostalgic, precious memory.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Wait a sec, Iori, why the hell haven't you kept in touch?！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, it's just... I didn't think I had the right to...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Huh? What do you mean, 'the right'? You're still getting hung up on the weirdest stuff, same as ever.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「...Then again, I can't put all the blame on you. I didn't reach out either, after all.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「My bad, Iori.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I'm the one who should be apologizing. That injury of yours, I...！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Whoa, hold on, we're not talking about that.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Listen, me getting hurt wasn't your fault. Next time you apologize to me for that, we're done being friends.」

name: Iori
message: 「G-Got it... Sorry.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Didn't I just tell you not to apologize?！ Man, you haven't changed a single bit since back then！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm relieved to see you haven't changed either.」
The voice reaching my ears was the exact same Takahisa from back when we were still students at the academy.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hey Iori, where are you these days, and what're you up to？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm with the Self-Defense Forces right now.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Aw, come on, don't be so cold. Tell me the truth. You're working as a teacher at Murakumo Academy, aren't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「T-That... how did you...？！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I heard it from Asahi.」
……I see. So that's how it is.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Murakumo Academy, brings back memories, doesn't it.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You said you wanted to be a teacher after you graduated, remember? It's great that your dream came true.」

name: Iori
message: 「……I'm only a teacher because I was ordered to from above. I'll be going back to the Ground Self-Defense Force once the mission is over.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Why? Why not just keep doing it, teaching? It's what you wanted to do, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「……No, I can't do that.」
How could I possibly be allowed to fulfill my own dream, when it was me who shattered yours?

name: Takahisa
message: 「I knew it, you're still hung up on my injury.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course I am.」
Ending Takahisa's career as an athlete is a sin I must carry with me for the rest of my life.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Seriously, you are just so damn inflexible……. Are you an idiot or what？」

name: Iori
message: 「Who are you calling an idiot? This is a conclusion I reached after serious consideration.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I'm calling you an idiot because you're stupidly serious. It doesn't matter what happened to my injury, does it?」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course it matters！ You were my best friend！」

name: Iori
message: 「I couldn't just stand by and be a person who could act like nothing happened after stealing my best friend's dream！！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I know that, dammit……！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I know that you're honorable, idiotically stubborn, and more compassionate than anyone else I've ever known！」
Takahisa lets out a deep sigh.

name: Takahisa
message: 「……I should have known better.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I couldn't bring myself to reach out to you. Man, I'm just pathetic.」

name: Iori
message: 「Takahisa……」

name: Takahisa
message: 「……To be honest, I did resent you at first. Thinking about how things could've been if I hadn't gotten injured.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm sorr……」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hey, cut it out! I told you not to apologize. Are you trying to get me to cut ties with you？」
I am cut off by Takahisa and fall silent.

name: Takahisa
message: 「……I was still just a brat when I graduated. I couldn't get over it.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I kept thinking, 'Nobody understands how I feel.' Acting like I was carrying all the misfortune in the world on my own shoulders.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Playing the tragic hero and thinking only about myself. I really am such an idiot...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Did you know? Asahi was aiming to become Toujinegi for my sake. Seeing how bitter I was that I couldn't achieve my dream.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that right...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I had no idea at all. It never even crossed my mind.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「And just like that, I was pushing the important people around me into a corner without even realizing it.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「That goes for you too, Iori.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「If I'd just stopped to think about it, I would've known right away how much you were suffering over injuring me.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Even so, I just couldn't bring myself to take that step, so I couldn't contact you until today.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「So, I know I'm way too late... but still, let me say this！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Iori, me getting hurt wasn't your fault.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「That was an accident that happened because two swordsmen fought each other in dead earnest.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「It was an accident, Iori.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「So you don't have to feel guilty about it at all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Takahisa……」

name: Takahisa
message: 「...I was the only one who could've told you that, too. Why didn't I say it sooner...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Seriously, I'm sick of how stupid I am. I've been regretting it this whole time.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Iori... I'm really sorry it took me so long.」
Before I knew it, the corners of my eyes grew hot.

name: Iori
message: 「Is that really okay？ What I did to you...！」
The words caught in my throat, and I couldn't get the rest out.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hey, do you remember, Iori?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Back in our first year, our homeroom teacher said something wrong, and when I pointed it out, he suddenly blew his top...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「And then he started saying, 'That constitutes disrespect! Apologize!' Remember when that happened？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I remember.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「And that's when you started saying stuff like, 'Why is an apology necessary for stating that what is wrong is wrong?'」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Seeing you get beat up by our homeroom teacher during disciplinary training right along with me, just for backing me up... that’s what I thought.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「That this guy’s gotta be a complete idiot.」

name: Iori
message: 「I didn't do anything wrong. That teacher is the one who's messed up.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「That was the moment. That’s when we became friends.」
Ah... that's right. We spent the whole night talking trash about our teacher and bonded.

name: Takahisa
message: 「You haven't changed a bit since then.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You were a sincere, stubborn, upright guy who hated anything crooked—a damn good, respectable person.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「That’s why you’ll surely make a great teacher. You ought to be one.」

name: Iori
message: 「But... you couldn't fulfill your dream. How could I just go and...」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Look, I had no choice but to give up on my dream, but that’s not the case for you, is it? You’re just giving up on your own.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Don't go throwing away something precious that easily.」

name: Iori
message: 「I didn't just throw it away on a whim. I thought about it, and I believed it was the right thing to do.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Playing the tragic hero and pretending you’re shouldering some great sin... nobody benefits from that, you know.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「In fact, you just end up hurting the people around you—the people who care about you.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Being that kind of idiot, one of me is more than enough.」

name: Iori
message: 「Takahisa……」
I had no words to retort.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Do it. Be a teacher.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Iori, live your life the way you want to.」
With those words from Takahisa.
The shackles that had kept me bound for so long—came crumbling down with a sound.

name: Iori
message: 「...Thank you, Takahisa.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Don't mention it, don't worry about it. We're friends, aren't we?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I guess we are.」
I replied, wiping the corner of my eye.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Hey, you're going to be at the academy for a while, right？ Can I come visit sometime？」

name: Iori
message: 「...I wonder about that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Once the Martial Festival is over, I might be called back to my original unit. If that happens, I’ll only be able to stay on as a teacher until the end of summer vacation.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Seriously？ You’re heading back to the JGSDF already！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I won’t know the details until I talk to the company commander, but…」
Still, based on the way he put it, there’s no doubt I’ll have to return at some point.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Then just quit the JGSDF already.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t say that so easily. I have a lot of attachment to that place.」
There are so many people there who took care of me, and my comrades. It’s not something I can just walk away from that easily.

name: Takahisa
message: 「But you’ve wanted to be a teacher for a long time, right? You’re really just going to throw that away and leave?」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s…」
Of course, I absolutely don’t want to throw it away.
However, the JGSDF—and the Tenju Special Forces—aren’t organizations where personal whims hold any sway.
If I’m ordered to return for duty, I won’t be able to refuse.

name: Iori
message: 「…But, you’re right.」

name: Iori
message: 「After you went through all the trouble of encouraging me, I hate the idea of giving up without trying anything.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ll look for a way to see if I can’t somehow get my deployment extended.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Yeah, you do that. Definitely do that.」
I’ll try making a proposal to the company commander as early as tomorrow.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Man, I finally got to say what I wanted to say, I feel so much better！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Alright, see ya later. I’m glad we got to talk today.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah… I’m really, really glad we talked.」
We promise to get in touch again soon, then end the call.

name: Iori
message: 「…It’s a nice night tonight.」
The night sky I looked up at seemed to shine just as brightly as it did that summer.
